description:
## Problem
After the rework only DuckDB can run TPC-DI. Doris ran the old TPC-DI.

## Owner decisions (choice dialogs, 2026-11-20)
- "SQL on DuckDB first, proven with the audit; then the other SQL platforms ... one PR each" and, for platforms without published results, "Plan a pull request for every one of them."
- "Allow third-party engine extensions for XML."
- "The TPC audit SQL is shipped unmodified. Only the specification's permitted minor substitutions are applied at run time, each recorded in the bundle."

## Change
Plan S12-S16 pattern for Doris: dialect rules for the ETL and appendix SQL, staging access (copying files to a stage is untimed), the type-2 update strategy, the visibility session, XML and FINWIRE parsing (engine-native or extension where the engine has one, recorded in the bundle), and adding the platform to the allowed list.

## Decision gates
A platform that needs more than the specification's permitted minor modifications of the audit SQL stops and asks the owner. The type-2 update strategy chosen for the platform is stated in the pull request. The platform runs locally (container via `mocker` where needed) through `make heavy-run`; if it cannot run locally, stop and report.

## Verification rubric
Pass: through `make heavy-run` at scale 3, a Doris run passes the full unmodified audit and produces a PASSED bundle with the label; the substitutions and any extension used are recorded in the bundle; a negative control fails the run; platforms not yet done still refuse; `make platform-manifest-check` and `make pr-preflight` pass.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
- The agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`.
- Arming: `make pr-arm` once; one more attempt only when the refusal named a cause, the agent reported it and the cause is cleared; never a third without asking. `make pr-rerun` at most once and only for a job the runner never ran or cancelled, never for a failed test.
- Review threads: reply; resolve only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise the finding again.
- Subagents are read-only. No file edit by script; use the edit tool. Do not edit a pull request description while its CI is starting; post a comment.
- Any limit, default, threshold, status token, message or label text the owner has not already chosen (see tpcdi-correction-plan-20261120) is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- A blocked step stops this item; no workaround. No live cloud run. Heavy work only through `make heavy-run`. One pull request for this item, merged before the next item starts.
- From the quarantine step until the reopening step, no TPC-DI entry point may produce a result that reads PASSED or is admitted for publication.
